title: Shelf Match Master
description: Organize bustling boutique supermarket shelves by dragging snacks, drinks, and plushies into neat matching trios before the clock winds down.
controls: Drag goods between shelf slots to line up three identical items on the same shelf and clear them in combos.

zh-CN.title: 货柜消除大师
zh-CN.description: 海内外爆款货架整理三消：在琳琅满目的多层货柜中挪动零食、饮品与潮玩，凑齐三个同款连击清空整排货架。
zh-CN.controls: 拖动任意商品到空位货架，同一格凑齐三个完全相同的商品即可自动消除，连消触发高倍加分。
